classes.name: WjButton
classes.description: A button over Optimus's `p-button`: 44 px tall by default, with the label, loading and disabled states of the default look. Put the click handler on `wj-button` itself. While `disabled` or `loading`, the button emits no `click` to it. Content you project (an icon, say) renders beside the `label`. Icon-only buttons set `ariaLabel`.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Text of the button. Rendered as text, never as HTML.

inputs.name: loading
inputs.description: Shows a spinner beside the label and makes the button inert.

inputs.name: variant
inputs.description: `outlined` or `text` fill instead of the solid one.

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: Accessible name when the button has no visible text. Set on the focusable element.

inputs.name: ariaLabelledBy
inputs.description: Id of the element that names the button. Set on the focusable element.

inputs.name: ariaDescribedBy
inputs.description: Id of the element that describes the button. Set on the focusable element.

inputs.name: pt
inputs.description: Pass-through for the button's parts. Tracks Optimus: its part names and attributes follow the installed `@openng/optimus-ui` minor and are outside this component's stable API; changes to them ship only in the release that takes a new Optimus minor and are not breaking.

types.name: WjButtonPt
types.description: Pass-through for `wj-button`'s parts. Tracks Optimus: its part names and attributes follow the installed `@openng/optimus-ui` minor and are outside this component's stable API; changes to them ship only in the release that takes a new Optimus minor and are not breaking.

types.name: WjButtonSeverity
types.description: Colour role of a `wj-button`. Left unset, the button takes the primary (ink) look.

types.name: WjButtonSize
types.description: Height step of a `wj-button`: 44 px by default, 36 px `small`, 52 px `large`.

types.name: WjButtonType
types.description: Native `type` of the button element. A button never submits a form unless it says `submit`.

types.name: WjButtonVariant
types.description: Fill of a `wj-button`: solid by default, or `outlined` or `text`.
